loading_messages: Remember to use the Manual on equipment to know what ammo it uses, or what it can be used for.
The Vehicle will only show 200 of it's hearts, don't be fooled.
Choose a faction by using an ID on a recruiter/arms-dealer
Shift to aim a gun while improving accuracy
Use an ID on vehicles to change it's faction
Homing missiles will lock onto the closest enemy vehicle
Guided-Missiles will go where you look!
Mines can be dug up when interacted with a Shovel
Barbed wire can be destroyed with Shears
AP shells deal more damage, but require you to hit your target directly.
HE shells deal less damage, but will still deal damage if it lands near your target.
Use your vehicle's machine-gun to know where your Tank's shell will land.
